stock_in_place_note: Release base (2026-11-02): translated stock modules classified A_unchanged, and MOD055 theme-only modules, run as stock code from the user file instead of compiled translations (analysis/release/RECONSTRUCTED_CLASSIFICATION.md). Deferred: host_layer_c (entries are aliases of readable names; needs its own pairing); ui_input_c (shares a stem with round 1; its entry 0x157c4 carries a parent hook); home_tick_c (entry name has no address) Round 3 (MOD120): host_layer_c unchanged modules (host_reply, host_receive, host_handlers, host_settings, preset_tlv, assign_refresh, factory_reset) via ENTRY_MODULES pairing. Round 4 (MOD121): colour-only modules ui_tuner_open, ui_browser_open, ui_widget_builders, ui_looper_mode and the home callbacks run as stock (theme swaps stay in the parent); ui_tasks, protocol_transport, input_pump and userdata_dispatch run as stock with their single call re-pointed by telemetry_c (gui), diagnostics_c (diag_usb_guard) and legacy_ui_c (wah_poll). Round 5 (MOD122): ui_effect_lifecycle and ui_home_open run as stock; legacy_ui_c points the stock constructors at legacy_editor_table / legacy_home_table and its window-4 stubs replay the stock prologue (PARENT_EDITS keeps the 26-entry home count). Round 6 (MOD123): ui_footswitch runs as stock with the press call re-pointed to gp50_fs_ab_press (refuse_c); ui_effect_set runs as stock with four own-C entry wrappers (A/B check) and exact stock-prologue replay tails. Round 7 (MOD124): ui_effect_tick (legacy_ui_c tick stub replays the stock prologue) and midi_program_dispatch (no context stub) run as stock. Round 8 (MOD125): ui_input_c ui_knob and input_scan run as stock (per-feature list: the shared ui_effect_set/ui_footswitch sources of ui_input_c stay C); parent redirects at reverted entries are restored to stock and declared. Round 9 (MOD126): ui_input_c fully stock (knob callback, encoder handler and footswitch toggle are unmodified). Round 10 (MOD127 build, not proposed alone): host_parse runs as stock; own_parse_entry.c handles our selectors (11/12 70-7f, 12 51) under the parser lock and sends everything else to the stock parser via its prologue-replay tail; own_read_table via 0x429ce/0x429d2; the MOD055 12 51 hook 0x4357a is restored. Round 12 (MOD129 build): preset_record read/migrate/apply run as stock (0x43fbc -> gp50_fs_ab_preset_read); fs_ab_preset_own.c keeps the factory-load wrapper and the refusal-aware save chain.
